Name: Night Owl Plus
Author: MaximillianRW
Description:
[color=#980000][size=3][b]Attention: This mod requires Game Version 1.6.10+ and SMAPI 4.1.0+[/b][/size][/color]

Night Owl Plus combines and extends the functionalities of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/433]Omegasis' Night Owl[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7592]su226's StayUp[/url] in an updated version. Thanks to both authors for the open source code and inspiration to make it possible. 


[b][u][size=3]Main Feature:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]No more forced passing out at 2AM. Stay awake for an entire 24h cycle.
[/list]

[b][u][size=3]Optional Features:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Internal Fish Data Editor, which makes fish appear past 2AM. Compatible with mods that add new fish to the game [b]AND[/b] CP compatibility to modders make their own late night fish times with version 1.1.0+ (with an example CP in the mod folder)! You can read more about it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2770]here[/url]﻿.
[*]Farmer and Horse position restored after saving at 6AM.
[*]Custom Stamina and Health restoration for sleeping late (with adjustable sleep hours needed to full rest).
[*]Exhaustion at turning to a new day awaken.
[*]Night-to-Day Light transition and Night Time Music for late night time.
[*]No clock shaking from 12AM to 2AM.
[/list]
All Optional Features are [b]enabled by default[/b] and configurable through [b]config.json[/b] or in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿. You can read more about them [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2687]here[/url].


[b][u][size=3]Update Instructions:[/size][/u][/b]
[u][i]From 1.0.x to 1.1.x[/i][/u] -> Delete the old Night Owl Plus folder from your Mods folder before extracting and moving the new one. To keep your configurations just save a backup of your [b]config.json[/b] and paste it back on [u]"Mods/Night Owl Plus/Night Owl Plus"[/u] folder (Not the "Night Owl Plus [CP]" one, and on the same level where is the [b]"NightOwlPlus.dll"[/b])


[b][u][size=3]Known Issues:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Night-to-Day Light transition is not as smooth as intended.
[*]Inside buildings and windows lights show day-light past 1:50AM.
[/list]

[b][u][size=3]Multiplayer Compatibility:[/size][/u][/b]
It was tested between two Windows Steam Players and it seems to work perfectly now (v. 1.1.0+)
Let me know if you find any issues.


[b][u]Currently Supported Languages:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]English (as default)
[*]Portuguese
[/list]
[u]To Translators:[/u]
This mod uses the i18n system. You have pre-given permission to release your own translations that adds the necessary files through Nexus.
To more info, refer to the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]wiki[/url].

My heartly thanks in advance to all authors that releases translations to this mod.


[b][u][size=3]Special Thanks:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Omegasis[/b] and [b]su226[/b] for the original mods and source.
[*][url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord[/url]﻿ community for all the help.
[/list]
